newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas says Heart River well 6,355 bpd.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas says Heart River well 6,355 bpd.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said its Heart River No. 1 discovery well in Dickinson, North Dakota, flow tested at 6,355 barrels of oil a day, the highest North Dakota well flow in recent history.
The well had initially been reported as flowing to sales at 4,500 barrels per day, before the addition of additional perforations in the productive zone, the company said.
The company said it conducted the flow test through a one-inch choke with a flowing tube pressure of 450 pounds per square inch, and electric logs indicated an oil column of 140 feet.
A first delineation well, the Dinsdale No. 2-4 has been drilled and logged, with an oil column of 140 feet, it said.

TransTexas said it expects this second well in the new field to be completed and flowing to sales by December 13. Drilling on a third well, the Dinsdale No. 1-3, is scheduled to immediately commence from the same pad.
The company believes it has two additional prospects in the area as indicated by 3-D seismic information and is attempting to secure a drilling rig to test them.
